# codebase-place-org-openclaw

Hybrid era where the place.org surface met OpenClaw orchestration. Evidence
that the surface↔orchestrator question has been live for a long time.

## Why this matters

Hybrid era where the place.org Next.js surface met OpenClaw orchestration. Evidence that the surface↔orchestrator question has been live longer than the current rewrite. Useful as comparison against `codebase-place-org` (pre-merge) and `lineage-openclaw` (orchestrator only).

## What lives here

- `code/place.org-openclaw/AGENTS.md`, `code/place.org-openclaw/CLAUDE.md` — agent-collaboration patterns at the merge point
- `code/place.org-openclaw/README.md`
- (Next.js app structure mirrors `codebase-place-org`)

## Where it connects

- Merges: `codebase-place-org` × `lineage-openclaw`
- Doctrine flowed forward into: `codebase-ema` (babysitter), `codebase-claudeforge` (surface seam)

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-place-org-openclaw:code/place.org-openclaw/AGENTS.md
```

## Doctrine extracted (2026-04-22)

Carries forward (principles, not code):
- **Additive-only fork seam** — orchestrator features are confined to a single namespaced directory; the surface is treated as read-only with exactly one named call-site to bootstrap, so upstream/orchestrator can evolve independently (`code/place.org-openclaw/CLAUDE.md` "Critical Rule" + "The ONE exception: `src/app/layout.tsx`"; `docs/openclaw/FORK-ARCHITECTURE.md` §1 "Additive Only").
- **Graceful degradation when the orchestrator is absent** — every orchestrator-dependent enhancement checks connection state first and renders nothing if the orchestrator is offline, so the surface collapses cleanly to its un-augmented form (`code/place.org-openclaw/CLAUDE.md` "Enhancement Pattern" — `if (!gatewayConnected) return null`).
- **Typed three-frame transport with authenticated handshake** — surface↔orchestrator traffic is exactly three JSON frame shapes (`req` / `res` / `event`) with monotonic `seq` on events and a challenge-response handshake bound to a cached device identity (`code/place.org-openclaw/CLAUDE.md` "Gateway Protocol"; `docs/openclaw/FORK-ARCHITECTURE.md` referenced auth flow).
- **Bounded extension points** — the seam between surface and orchestrator is enumerated as a fixed small number of named extension points (app-registry merge, layout init, etc.), not an open ABI, so drift is detectable by counting touch-sites (`docs/openclaw/FORK-ARCHITECTURE.md` §4 "exactly **4 extension points**").

Leaves behind (residue):
- The Next.js / Zustand / `src/openclaw/` directory layout and the WebSocket port `18789` (`code/place.org-openclaw/CLAUDE.md` "Architecture").
- The git workflow specifics (`upstream` remote, `git merge upstream/main`, fork-sync cron) (`docs/openclaw/FORK-ARCHITECTURE.md` §2 "Git Setup").

Topic relevance: `surface`, `orchestration`, `transport`, `identity`, `doctrine`, `placement`.
